title: Coroutines: suspend, launch, async and the dispatcher

videos.script: The planner loads the week from a file, or from a server. Loading takes time, and the thread that draws the screen must not wait for it. {{gradle}} Coroutines are a library, so this lesson starts by building the first Gradle project of the course. Two small files, a wrapper, and a first build that downloads what it needs. {{suspend}} Then suspend: a function that can pause in the middle, give its thread away, and carry on where it stopped. {{launch}} Launch, which starts a coroutine beside the current one. Two of them take turns on one thread, at every delay. {{async}} Async and await, for two loads that run side by side and finish in the time of the longer one. {{dispatch}} Dispatchers, which decide which threads do the work, and withContext, which moves it. {{many}} And a hundred thousand coroutines, waiting one second each, finishing in one second, on one thread.
